title: Ecosystem assessor input
description: Input for evaluator/cli/assess_ecosystem.py. A file that omits hard_gates does not pass the eight governance gates. annual_reserve_expansion_usd is recorded and is not part of portfolio coverage.

annual_reserve_expansion_usd.description: Inflationary or reserve expansion. Not included in indicator 11 or in portfolio coverage.

annual_yield_net_usd.description: Counted in portfolio coverage (gate 3) only. Not counted in indicator 11.

annual_pledges_net_usd.description: Counted in portfolio coverage (gate 3) only when the figure is cash already received. Not counted in indicator 11.

indicator.description: Boolean true scores 5 and false scores 0. A number scores 5 at 5 or above, 3 at 3 or 4, and 0 below 3. Strings are not scores.

hardGates.description: Evidence for the eight governance gates. Omitting this object leaves every gate NOT MET.

measurement_verified.description: Gate 1. True only when the annual maintenance cost floor is empirically verified. Also requires annual_maintenance_budget_usd > 0.

cash_evidence_audited.description: Gate 2. True only when inflows are audited cash or stablecoin receipts.

revenue_classes.description: Gate 4. At least two distinct correlation classes.

largest_payer_share.description: Gate 5. Largest single payer share of recurring net inflows. Met only when the share is from 0 through 0.25.

stress_coverage_ratio.description: Gate 6, with stressed_runway_months. Stress coverage ratio. Met only at 1.0 or above.

stressed_runway_months.description: Gate 6, with stress_coverage_ratio. Operating liquidity under the compound stress case, in months. Met only at 24 or above.

liabilities_covered.description: Gate 7. True only when contractual obligations and retainers are backed by capacity and wind-down reserves.

independent_audit_published.description: Gate 8. True only when an independent party has published the annual audit.
